verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API with API-key auth that retrieves conversations, transcripts, action items, insights and outlines, so scripts can pull most of the requested data. However, the API is limited to Enterprise workspaces, nothing shows keys are self-serve, and the documentation is a single prose help article with no machine-readable spec, interactive reference or sandbox. missing for 10: evidence of self-serve key issuance outside Enterprise sales, an explicit summaries endpoint (only outlines/insights are named), an OpenAPI spec or interactive reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms
